A_admission.statement: A increments Requests on the account currently at p.Target during admission, before the callback is returned.

A_success.statement: A's callback increments Successes on the current account, when its epoch matches.
A_success.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_only_success_field.statement: Invoking A's returned callback does not change Requests.
A_only_success_field.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same A callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.
A_repeat.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_no_dispatch.statement: A places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.
A_no_dispatch.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_invalid_admission.statement: A panics on the Requests field dereference if p.Target is nil.

B_admission.statement: B increments Requests on the previously captured target during admission, before the callback is returned.

B_success.statement: B's callback increments Successes on the captured target.

B_only_success_field.statement: Invoking B's returned callback does not change Requests.

B_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same B callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.

B_no_dispatch.statement: B places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.

B_invalid_admission.statement: B panics at the Requests field dereference if the captured target is nil.

C_admission.statement: C increments Requests on the previously captured target during admission, before the callback is returned.

C_success.statement: C's callback increments Successes on the captured target, when both identity and epoch match.
C_success.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_only_success_field.statement: Invoking C's returned callback does not change Requests.
C_only_success_field.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same C callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.
C_repeat.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_no_dispatch.statement: C places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.
C_no_dispatch.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_invalid_admission.statement: C panics while reading p.Target.Epoch if p.Target is nil, before the Requests increment.

D_admission.statement: D increments Requests on the current occupant of the supplied key during admission, before the callback is returned.

D_success.statement: D's callback increments Successes on the current non-nil occupant of the admitted key.
D_success.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_only_success_field.statement: Invoking D's returned callback does not change Requests.
D_only_success_field.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same D callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.
D_repeat.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_no_dispatch.statement: D places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.
D_no_dispatch.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_invalid_admission.statement: D's admission dereferences the key lookup result for Requests without a nil guard.

E_admission.statement: E increments Requests on the account pointed to by the value receiver's Target during admission, before the callback is returned.

E_success.statement: E's callback increments Successes on the target pointer in the copied Port receiver.

E_only_success_field.statement: Invoking E's returned callback does not change Requests.

E_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same E callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.

E_no_dispatch.statement: E places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.

E_invalid_admission.statement: E panics at the admission Requests field dereference if its copied Target is nil.

F_admission.statement: F increments Requests on the previously captured target during admission, before the callback is returned.

F_success.statement: F's callback increments Successes on the captured target.

F_only_success_field.statement: Invoking F's returned callback does not change Requests.

F_repeat.statement: Each invocation of the same F callback that meets its increment conditions can add one success, including a second eligible invocation.

F_no_dispatch.statement: F places the Successes increment inside the returned callback; returning the callback does not run its body.

F_invalid_admission.statement: F panics at the Requests field dereference if the captured target is nil.

A_saved_epoch.statement: A saves the admitting account's numeric Epoch value.

A_same_epoch_other_target.statement: After rebinding to a distinct account with the saved epoch, A's callback increments that replacement's Successes.
A_same_epoch_other_target.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_skip_mismatched_epoch.statement: When the live target's epoch differs from the saved value, A's callback increments no Successes.
A_skip_mismatched_epoch.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_nil_target_panic.statement: When the live target is nil at invocation, A's callback panics while evaluating p.Target.Epoch.
A_nil_target_panic.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_later_eligible.statement: After an invocation that skipped for an epoch mismatch, a later invocation of the same A callback with a live target whose epoch now matches increments that target's Successes.
A_later_eligible.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

A_after_panic.statement: After a recovered nil-target panic, invoking the same A callback with a reattached matching target increments its Successes.
A_after_panic.fragment: return func() { if p.Target.Epoch == epoch { p.Target.Successes++ } }

B_capture.statement: B assigns the admission-time account pointer to the local target.

B_rebinding.statement: B's callback increments the admitted account's Successes even after the Port is rebound or detached.

B_epoch.statement: An epoch change on the captured account does not prevent B's callback from incrementing it.

B_live_counter.statement: B's callback increments the captured account's current Successes field value, including a value assigned after admission.

C_capture.statement: C saves the admission-time account pointer and its numeric Epoch.

C_skip_other_target.statement: C's callback adds no success when the current target is a different account even if that account has the saved epoch.
C_skip_other_target.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_skip_changed_epoch.statement: C's callback adds no success when the original account is still the target but no longer has the saved epoch.
C_skip_changed_epoch.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_skip_nil_target.statement: After a valid C admission, a nil Port.Target makes the identity comparison false and short-circuits the epoch comparison.
C_skip_nil_target.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

C_later_eligible.statement: After an invocation of C's callback with a false guard, a later invocation of the same callback increments Successes once both original identity and saved epoch match.
C_later_eligible.fragment: return func() { if p.Target == target && target.Epoch == epoch { target.Successes++ } }

D_new_key_occupant.statement: When the admitted key is rebound to another account, D's existing callback increments the new occupant's Successes.
D_new_key_occupant.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_whole_map.statement: D's callback looks up the admitted key in the Registry's current Entries field, including after assigning a new non-nil map.
D_whole_map.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_other_key.statement: D's callback does not look up a different key in the Registry.
D_other_key.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_absent.statement: D's callback does not increment Successes when the admitted key is absent.
D_absent.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_nil_entry.statement: D's callback does not increment Successes when the admitted key is present with a nil value.
D_nil_entry.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_nil_map.statement: D's callback does not increment Successes when Entries is a nil map and the Registry receiver remains non-nil.
D_nil_map.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_later_eligible.statement: After a skipped invocation on a missing or nil entry, a later invocation of the same D callback increments a non-nil account subsequently bound to the same key.
D_later_eligible.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_epoch.statement: A different epoch on the account at the key does not prevent the D callback from incrementing it.
D_epoch.fragment: return func() { if target := r.Entries[key]; target != nil { target.Successes++ } }

D_admission_missing.statement: During D admission, a missing key yields a nil account pointer and the unguarded Requests field dereference panics.

D_admission_nil_entry.statement: During D admission, a key whose value is nil results in a panic at the Requests field dereference.

D_admission_nil_map.statement: During D admission, a nil Entries map yields a nil account pointer at the key and the Requests field dereference panics.

E_value_receiver.statement: E declares a Port value receiver, so the receiver is a Port value copy with a copied Target pointer.

E_rebinding.statement: E's callback increments the account addressed through the receiver copy after the caller rebinds or detaches its Port.

E_epoch.statement: An epoch change on the account addressed through the receiver copy does not prevent E's callback from incrementing it.

F_capture.statement: F assigns the admission-time account pointer to the local target.

F_rebinding.statement: F's callback increments the admitted account's Successes even after the Port is rebound or detached.

F_epoch.statement: An epoch change on the captured account does not prevent F's callback from incrementing it.
